rules.title: Refund is due
rules.message: The automatic refund runs only after the shipment deadline. Before that, the seller still has time to ship.

rules.title: Nothing was shipped
rules.message: If the named carrier already recorded a shipment, the never-shipped refund does not apply. A dispute does not block this refund: it is the outcome for a sale that was never performed.

rules.title: Valid refund
rules.message: The refund pays the buyer and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Everything goes back to the buyer
rules.message: The buyer gets back every last cent in the account, with no fee.

rules.title: Release is due
rules.message: The automatic release runs only after the inspection deadline, and only once a shipment was recorded. It does not lapse because an arbiter stayed silent.

rules.title: A shipment was recorded
rules.message: Without a recorded shipment the seller is not paid. That deal refunds instead.

rules.title: No open dispute
rules.message: An open buyer dispute blocks the automatic release until the account closes. Time passing, including the arbiter's deadline, does not clear it.

rules.title: The price is in the account
rules.message: The release needs at least the price in the account. Anything more does not stop it: it goes back to the buyer.

rules.title: Valid release
rules.message: The release pays the seller (less the fee), returns anything extra to the buyer, and closes the account.

rules.title: Seller gets the price, the buyer gets any extra
rules.check: def.toSeller + def.toFee == def.price && def.toFee == bps(def.toSeller + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps) && def.toBuyer + def.price == def.balance && tx.payouts.hasResidual() == (def.balance > def.price)
rules.message: The seller is paid exactly the price, less the fee. Anything else in the account goes back to the buyer. Of the two releases signed in advance, only the one that fits the balance can be used.

rules.title: Valid confirmation
rules.message: The buyer confirming receipt splits the money and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Seller and fee make the price
rules.message: The seller and the service fee together equal the price. Anything extra can go back to the buyer.

rules.title: Correct service fee
rules.message: The service takes 0.5% of the price the seller receives. Money returned to the buyer carries no fee.

rules.title: Pays only buyer, seller and fee
rules.message: A confirmation can only pay the buyer, the seller, and the service fee.

rules.title: Valid agreed refund
rules.message: An agreed cancel sends everything to the buyer and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Full balance to the buyer
rules.message: Everything in the account goes back to the buyer, with no fee.
